summary_en: Area Quest Inc. executed a share buyback of 400,200 shares at 158 yen per share on November 11, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, totaling 63.23 million yen, representing 2.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Exchange Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Area Quest Inc. announced the execution of a treasury stock buyback approved by its Board of Directors on November 10, 2026. The company purchased 400,200 shares at a fixed price of 158 yen per share on November 11, 2026 via off-exchange transaction (ToSTNeT-3), resulting in a total acquisition amount of 63.23 million yen. This represents 2.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, calculated from the stated 14.74 million shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock).

The acquisition was executed as a single off-exchange transaction at the closing price on November 10, 2026. The company placed a buy order limited to the designated trading window at 8:45 AM on November 11 and did not modify the order quantity or shift to alternative trading methods, despite the possibility that some or all of the acquisition might not be executed due to market conditions.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to enhance shareholder returns through improved capital efficiency and to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business environments.
